title: T14 Candlesticks: Open, High, Low, Close

lines.text: Lesson fourteen: candlesticks. Open, high, low and close.
lines.say: Lesson fourteen: candlesticks. Open, high, low and close.

lines.text: Almost every price chart you will see is drawn this way.
lines.say: Almost every price chart you will see is drawn this way.

lines.text: Here is one minute of a fictional BTC price, drawn as a line.
lines.say: Here is one minute of a fictional B-T-C price, drawn as a line.

lines.text: A line shows every wiggle. Now watch it squeeze into one shape.
lines.say: A line shows every wiggle. Now watch it squeeze into one shape.

lines.text: That shape is a candle. It keeps just four prices from the minute.
lines.say: That shape is a candle. It keeps just four prices from the minute.

lines.text: Candles side by side make a chart.
lines.say: Candles side by side make a chart.

lines.text: A candle sums up one time window, such as one minute, with four prices.
lines.say: A candle sums up one time window, such as one minute, with four prices.

lines.text: Open is the first price. Close is the last. High and low are the extremes.
lines.say: Open is the first price. Close is the last. High and low are the extremes.

lines.text: Think of one day's temperature: first reading, hottest, coldest, last.
lines.say: Think of one day's temperature: first reading, hottest, coldest, last.

lines.text: Same idea. A candle is a price summary, not a prediction.
lines.say: Same idea. A candle is a price summary, not a prediction.

lines.text: Let's watch a 1-minute candle form.
lines.say: Let's watch a one-minute candle form.

lines.text: It starts at 60,000 USDT. That first price is the open.
lines.say: It starts at sixty thousand U-S-D-T. That first price is the open.

lines.text: Price dips below the open, so the forming body is red. The lowest point is the low.
lines.say: Price dips below the open, so the forming body is red. The lowest point is the low.

lines.text: Now price climbs above the open: the body turns green. Each new top is the high.
lines.say: Now price climbs above the open: the body turns green. Each new top is the high.

lines.text: Until the minute ends, the last price keeps changing. The candle is not finished.
lines.say: Until the minute ends, the last price keeps changing. The candle is not finished.

lines.text: Time is up. The last price, 60,080, becomes the close. The candle is done.
lines.say: Time is up. The last price, sixty thousand eighty, becomes the close. The candle is done.

lines.text: Open, high, low, close: four numbers that tell this minute's story.
lines.say: Open, high, low, close: four numbers that tell this minute's story.

lines.text: Let's name the parts. The thick part is the body, between open and close.
lines.say: Let's name the parts. The thick part is the body, between open and close.

lines.text: The thin lines are wicks, also called shadows. They reach the high and the low.
lines.say: The thin lines are wicks, also called shadows. They reach the high and the low.

lines.text: Body: 60,080 minus 60,000 is 80 USDT. Upper wick: 40. Lower wick: 60.
lines.say: Body: sixty thousand eighty minus sixty thousand is eighty U-S-D-T. Upper wick: forty. Lower wick: sixty.

lines.text: The range, high minus low, is 180 USDT. More than half of it is wick.
lines.say: The range, high minus low, is one hundred eighty U-S-D-T. More than half of it is wick.

lines.text: Up or down? Compare the close with the open.
lines.say: Up or down? Compare the close with the open.

lines.text: Close above open: an up candle, also called bullish. Usually drawn green.
lines.say: Close above open: an up candle, also called bullish. Usually drawn green.

lines.text: Close below open: a down candle, called bearish. Usually drawn red.
lines.say: Close below open: a down candle, called bearish. Usually drawn red.

lines.text: Same high and low, same 80 USDT body. Only the direction differs.
lines.say: Same high and low, same eighty U-S-D-T body. Only the direction differs.

lines.text: Colours are just an app setting. Open versus close is what counts.
lines.say: Colours are just an app setting. Open versus close is what counts.

lines.text: Sometimes the close lands almost exactly on the open.
lines.say: Sometimes the close lands almost exactly on the open.

lines.text: Here: open 60,000, close 60,005. The body is just 5 USDT thin.
lines.say: Here: open sixty thousand, close sixty thousand five. The body is just five U-S-D-T thin.

lines.text: That is a doji. Buyers and sellers ended the minute about even.
lines.say: That is a doji. Buyers and sellers ended the minute about even.

lines.text: A doji does not tell you what comes next.
lines.say: A doji does not tell you what comes next.

lines.text: Four prices, but they are not free. Two rules always hold.
lines.say: Four prices, but they are not free. Two rules always hold.

lines.text: The high can never be below the open or the close. It is the top.
lines.say: The high can never be below the open or the close. It is the top.

lines.text: The low can never be above them either. It is the bottom.
lines.say: The low can never be above them either. It is the bottom.

lines.text: Drop the close below the open, and the candle turns red.
lines.say: Drop the close below the open, and the candle turns red.

lines.text: Rule check: high is at or above both, low at or below both. Always.
lines.say: Rule check: high is at or above both, low at or below both. Always.

lines.text: One candle covers one minute. Put candles side by side, and you get a chart.
lines.say: One candle covers one minute. Put candles side by side, and you get a chart.

lines.text: Time runs left to right. Price runs bottom to top.
lines.say: Time runs left to right. Price runs bottom to top.

lines.text: Each new candle opens near where the last one closed.
lines.say: Each new candle opens near where the last one closed.

lines.text: The candle on the far right is still forming. It can change until its minute ends.
lines.say: The candle on the far right is still forming. It can change until its minute ends.

lines.text: A common mistake: reading the top of the wick as the close.
lines.say: A common mistake: reading the top of the wick as the close.

lines.text: Price did touch 60,200 in that minute, but it did not stay there.
lines.say: Price did touch sixty thousand two hundred in that minute, but it did not stay there.

lines.text: The close is the edge of the body. On this green candle, the top edge: 60,040.
lines.say: The close is the edge of the body. On this green candle, the top edge: sixty thousand forty.

lines.text: Wick tips are the high and low. Body edges are the open and close.
lines.say: Wick tips are the high and low. Body edges are the open and close.

lines.text: Your turn. Read this candle's open, high, low and close.
lines.say: Your turn. Read this candle's open, high, low and close.

lines.text: Is it an up or a down candle? Pause if you need more time.
lines.say: Is it an up or a down candle? Pause if you need more time.

lines.text: Open 60,150 at the top of the red body. Close 60,000 at the bottom.
lines.say: Open sixty thousand one hundred fifty at the top of the red body. Close sixty thousand at the bottom.

lines.text: High 60,200, low 59,950. Close is 150 below open: a down candle.
lines.say: High sixty thousand two hundred, low fifty-nine thousand nine hundred fifty. Close is one hundred fifty below open: a down candle.

lines.text: Well done if you got it.
lines.say: Well done if you got it.

lines.text: Before we move on, keep these limits in mind.
lines.say: Before we move on, keep these limits in mind.

lines.text: A candle shows what already happened. It does not predict the next one.
lines.say: A candle shows what already happened. It does not predict the next one.

lines.text: The last candle can still change. Big wicks mean fast moves and more slippage.
lines.say: The last candle can still change. Big wicks mean fast moves and more slippage.

lines.text: Nothing here is a signal. Waiting, or no trade at all, is always allowed.
lines.say: Nothing here is a signal. Waiting, or no trade at all, is always allowed.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: A candle sums up one time window: open, high, low and close.
lines.say: A candle sums up one time window: open, high, low and close.

lines.text: Body edges are open and close. Wick tips are high and low.
lines.say: Body edges are open and close. Wick tips are high and low.

lines.text: Up candles close above the open; down candles close below.
lines.say: Up candles close above the open; down candles close below.

lines.text: Check yourself: a red body runs from 60,100 down to 60,020. Where did it open?
lines.say: Check yourself: a red body runs from sixty thousand one hundred down to sixty thousand twenty. Where did it open?

lines.text: At 60,100, the top of the red body. It closed lower, at 60,020.
lines.say: At sixty thousand one hundred, the top of the red body. It closed lower, at sixty thousand twenty.

lines.text: Great work! Next up: 1-minute, 5-minute and 15-minute timeframes.
lines.say: Great work! Next up: one-minute, five-minute and fifteen-minute timeframes.

lines.text: See you in lesson fifteen.
lines.say: See you in lesson fifteen.
